info.title: Ophiolite public API
info.description: One public API for every project operation. Three credential kinds reach it: the browser session (opaque HttpOnly cookie plus the X-CSRF-Token proof and, on non-GET requests, the exact Origin), a project-scoped delegate lasting at most five minutes (Bearer oph_api_..., parent session and current native permissions remain mandatory), and a browser-approved provider grant (Bearer provider token plus X-Ophiolite-Application-Grant, capability 1: the scientific read resources and the applications route within its read/write scopes). A request that carries an Authorization header is a machine request and is refused with MACHINE_AUTH_REQUIRED when a cookie or Origin travels with it. Scope and capability are ceilings; every operation runs the same native permission checks whoever calls it. Not a stable SDK or unattended service-account contract.

x-ophiolite-deprecated-aliases.condition: Removed after every Integration caller listed in docs/api-routes.md has moved to the public routes; not before E5.

get.description: Public description; carries no project data. Lists every schema, profile and document with display names, versions and lifecycle badges. Reachable with or without browser cookies.

Serves the document at a registry-relative path only if the index lists it (schemas[].path, profiles[].path, documents[].path); any other path is 404 not-found and no filesystem lookup happens. Schema ids contain "/", so documents are addressed by path; the index maps ids to paths.

200.description: The document bytes with their media type

schema.description: A listed registry document; its shape is the schema the index names for it

404.description: Path not listed by the index

bearer.description: A project delegate (oph_api_...) or a provider access token with X-Ophiolite-Application-Grant; never with a browser cookie or Origin

session.name: ab_session
session.description: The browser session; X-CSRF-Token must equal the session proof on every request, and non-GET requests carry the exact Origin

ContractsRegistry.title: ContractsRegistry
ContractsRegistry.description: The registry index. Ids follow id_grammar; versions are semver of the document; paths are registry-relative and never leave contracts/.
